primary_method: Per-subject joint-centre spans from the committed ANSUR II male file (n = 4,082), using the landmark-to-joint conversions corroborated in proportion_audit.py, regressed on stature and evaluated at 1.82 m.
why_ansur_primary: Stature-conditioned, large, committed and recomputable; its HJC/KJC/EJC conversions were independently corroborated on 7 October. Trotter-Gleser measures dry-bone maximum lengths (1950s US white men) and needs endpoint allowances; de Leva is a 100-athlete proportion table scaled linearly, three of four values unverified here.

thigh_HJC_KJC.definition: (trochanterion height - 8 mm) - lateral femoral epicondyle height; vertical span in standing
thigh_HJC_KJC.caveat: femoral mechanical axis is within a few degrees of vertical in standing, so the 3-D span is longer by under 0.5%
thigh_HJC_KJC.trotter_gleser_conversion: femur max - head radius 24.7 mm - KJC-to-plateau 27.0 mm

sensitivity_mm.trotter_gleser_inversion: inverting stature-on-bone overstates bone length above the sample mean stature

thigh_HJC_KJC.reading: CONTESTED: ANSUR 419 (a003 within 0.3 SD) against de Leva 441 and Trotter-Gleser 455 (inflated by inversion). The HJC-trochanterion relation moves ANSUR by up to 16 mm. Resolve endpoint definitions before selecting; a003 is not established as short.

shank_KJC_AJC.definition: lateral femoral epicondyle height - lateral malleolus height; vertical span
shank_KJC_AJC.caveat: ISB AJC is the malleolar midpoint; the medial malleolus sits higher, so AJC is a few mm above the lateral malleolus and this span is slightly long
shank_KJC_AJC.trotter_gleser_conversion: TG white-male tibia omits the malleolus (Jantz 1995); no defensible joint-span conversion here
shank_KJC_AJC.reading: CONSISTENT: a003 matches ANSUR; de Leva is +16 mm (about 1.1 SD, unverified value).

upper_arm_GH_EJC.definition: acromion-radiale length - 15 mm (radiale below EJC) - GH depth below acromion skin (47 mm, corroborated by Arm26 47 mm / Rajagopal 53.5 mm)
upper_arm_GH_EJC.caveat: GH depth uncertainty is about +/- 7 mm between the two open models
upper_arm_GH_EJC.trotter_gleser_conversion: humerus max - 24.7 mm head - 12 mm distal allowance
upper_arm_GH_EJC.reading: CONSISTENT: ANSUR and de Leva agree within 1 SD and a003 matches; the Trotter-Gleser conversion (+37 mm) depends on an uncertain distal allowance and the inversion bias.

forearm_EJC_WJC.definition: radiale-stylion length + 15 mm (EJC above radiale); WJC taken at stylion level
forearm_EJC_WJC.caveat: ISB WJC is the styloid midpoint, a few mm proximal of the radial styloid tip, so this span is slightly long
forearm_EJC_WJC.trotter_gleser_conversion: radius max + 15 mm (radial head top is about radiale)
forearm_EJC_WJC.reading: ROBUST: ANSUR, Trotter-Gleser and de Leva lie within about 1 SD of each other (281-293 mm); a003 is 25-37 mm short under every method. Lengthen.

not_decided_here: endpoint mapping of each span onto the canonical bone geometry (head, condyles, trochlea, styloids)
left/right identical by policy unless evidence says otherwise
whether to adopt ANSUR or reconcile with de Leva where they disagree
